criteria.assertion: Exact PR18 base; read-only source/data review; only allocated reviewer docs/evidence may be created. No wrapper/identity/policy changes or native imports/execution.
Map actual wrapper consumer function, nine action keys, JSON selectors, exact known sizes/SHA pins and unresolved constants; distinguish direct runtime inputs from human review dependencies.
Independently hash locally retained verified source/provenance records; distinguish actual raw bytes from relay derivatives, parent materialization claims and truncated local candidate evidence.
Use exact supplied manifest member names/identities; request minimal missing members for next review, never generic complete-packet resend and never imply globally absent when only locally missing.
Keep original collector receipt, original source-verification, prior audit reference, previous supervisor receipt and ZIP member manifest separate; no schema/content/completeness substitution.

Describe sourceVerification relative $.files[].path versus priorManifest absolute $.files[].path, both byte/hash fields and finite existing bounds; unknown source count/schema is not permission to truncate or widen.

Pin selected executable known size/hash separately from Git known path and absent size/hash; preserve failed timestamp/bracket and bounded-hash flags, historical wrapper uncertainty, watchdog/runtime/publication HOLD.
Publish no private paths/bodies; retain only member/JSON selectors/size/hash and analysis. Final verdict covers exact-input conclusions, not source execution readiness or native admission.
